title: Beverly hovering metallic object

tellings.quote: Beverly, Massachusetts, 1966. Uh, nine witnesses, two law enforcement officers see a metallic platelike object

plain: In Beverly, Massachusetts, in 1966, nine witnesses, two of them police officers, saw a metallic, plate-like object. A writer named Marik von Rennenkampff gives the case as an example on the show during a debate with Mick West, a well-known UFO skeptic, and he names no source. He uses it as the kind of sighting that has several witnesses, some of them officials, and that is hard to explain away.
